title: Beyond branches, among leaves
odia:
ତୁ ଗଲେ ଡାଳେ ଡାଳେ
ମୁଁ ଯିବି ପତରେ ପତରେ।
literal_meaning: If you go from branch to branch, I shall go from leaf to leaf.
meaning_odia: ତୁମେ ଡାଳେ ଡାଳେ ଗଲେ ମୁଁ ପତରେ ପତରେ ଯିବି—ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ତୁମ ଚାଲର ଉତ୍ତରରେ ମୁଁ ଆହୁରି ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ଚାଲ ଖେଳିପାରିବି ବୋଲି ବକ୍ତା ଦାବି କରୁଛନ୍ତି। ଏହା ପରସ୍ପରକୁ ଟପିଯିବାର ଆହ୍ୱାନ; ସଫଳତାର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ନୁହେଁ। ପାଠ-ଟୀକା: ମୂଳ ଜିବିକୁ ଯିବା କ୍ରିୟାର ମାନକ ରୂପ ଯିବି କରାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The response promises a more finely placed move for every move the other person makes. Branches give way to leaves: the speaker claims they cannot easily be outwitted. This is a challenge or boast, with no outcome narrated. Textual note: uploaded ଜିବି has been editorially regularised to ଯିବି, “I shall go.”
usage_example: Original imagined example: During a friendly strategy game, one player announces a clever plan. The other answers with the branch-and-leaf saying, promising an answer to every move.
cultural_context: The repeated phrases give the two voices matching rhythms, while the shift from branch to leaf makes the reply sound more exact and nimble. No particular tree or literal journey is identified.

witnesses.locator: Page22, fifth item beginning ତୁ ଗଲେ ଡାଳେ ଡାଳେ.
witnesses.note: Original second line: ମୁଁ ଜିବି ପତରେ ପତରେ। Display changes ଜିବି→ଯିବି as an explicit editorial regularisation of the verb “go”; parallel grammar and a public counterpart with ଯିବା support the reading, not the exact replacement form. ମୂଳ ଜିବିକୁ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ଭାବେ ଯିବି କରାଯାଇଛି।
